recursivefactory.configuration.title: Recursive Factory Settings
Control rotation, fluid and item transfer independently.
recursivefactory.configuration.repairBro: Restore missing checkerboard tiles when preparing a room. Existing blocks are preserved.
recursivefactory.configuration.linkEnabl: Connect paired surface nodes when Create: Electro Energetics is installed.
recursivefactory.configuration.linkResis: Series resistance per end. The default of 10 ohms keeps the connected grids stable.
recursivefactory.configuration.linkRespo: Fraction of the target adjustment applied each tick.
recursivefactory.configuration.linkMaxCu: Maximum current requested by each end of a link.
Allow factory entrances and room barriers to transfer rotation and stress. Enabled by default; disabled by default when Create Ender Transmission (createendertransmission) is loaded. Saved choices take priority.
Allow factory entrances and room barriers to transfer fluids. Enabled by default; disabled by default when Create Ender Transmission (createendertransmission) is loaded. Saved choices take priority.
Allow factory entrances and room barriers to transfer items. Enabled by default; disabled by default when Create Ender Transmission (createendertransmission) is loaded. Saved choices take priority.

recursivefactory.ponder.connections.head: Connecting the inside and outside
recursivefactory.ponder.connections.text: Each entrance face connects to the wall facing the same direction inside its room.
Input from the north reaches the north wall. Place the receiving container against that wall.
Enable redstone at both ends with a normal wrench right-click, or sneak-right-click with empty hands.
Engineer goggles show the selected face, server transfer settings and waiting buffers.
recursivefactory.ponder.expansion.text_1: One entrance represents a 16 by 16 by 16 room cell. Enter with an empty-hand right-click.
recursivefactory.ponder.expansion.text_2: Place entrances beside, above or below an existing entrance to expand the same factory in that shape.
recursivefactory.ponder.expansion.text_3: An entrance placed inside a room creates a nested factory. Copies receive independent rooms.
recursivefactory.ponder.expansion.text_4: Right-click a barrier to return one level. Each entrance still transfers through its own room cell.
recursivefactory.ponder.printing.text_1: Use Schematic and Quill to select an entrance, save the schematic, then deploy it for the Schematicannon.
recursivefactory.ponder.printing.text_2: Supply gunpowder and construction materials in adjacent containers. Missing materials pause construction.
recursivefactory.ponder.printing.text_3: The entrance is placed first. The cannon then builds the captured room contents one block at a time.
recursivefactory.ponder.printing.text_4: Refill missing materials to continue. Progress survives saving; expanded and nested rooms are copied independently.
